hazard.description:
A defect has been identified in some products where localized overheating and scorching of the LED module may cause discoloration and carbonization inside the product, or melting of the lens and cover. Accordingly, the affected products are being recalled and will be exchanged free of charge for new products without defects.
Cases have been reported in some products of damage to the LED module, lens, and cover, as well as fire incidents. Due to concerns about burns from overheating and damage to surrounding property, free exchange is being carried out. For your safety, stop using the product and apply for an exchange.
hazard.description_original: 일부 제품에서 LED 모듈의 국부적 과열·소손으로 제품 내부가 변색·탄화되거나 렌즈와 커버가 용융될 수 있는 결함이 확인되었습니다. 이에 대상 제품을 회수하고 결함이 없는 새 제품으로 무상 교환합니다.

corrective_action.description:
1 Immediately stop using the ceiling light, and turn off the lighting switch and the corresponding circuit breaker to disconnect the power supply.
2 Only after the product has sufficiently cooled down and it is safe to approach, support the cover with both hands and turn it counterclockwise to remove it. If the cover does not open easily or it is difficult to work at height, do not attempt to force it and contact the service desk.
3 Do not touch or remove the wires, terminals, or LED modules. Instead, photograph the entire product, the entire internal module on the inside of the cover, and the label showing the model name, manufacturing date, or LOT.
4 Send the photos, product quantity, and a phone number where you can be contacted by text message to 010-7310-8024. Even if the label is missing or difficult to read, you can request verification using the internal photos.
5 After confirming eligibility, a new product will be sent free of charge. Replace the existing product with the new one and do not reuse the existing product. Collection and removal of the existing product and installation of the new product will be arranged in consultation with the company at the time of registration. The company will bear the cost of shipping the new product, return courier fees, and removal and installation.
